fields.summary_ko.0: Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) disclosed the cause of July software defect leading to major Outlook and Microsoft 365 outage, with over 80% of servers becoming unresponsive during peak US business hours on November 12.
fields.summary_ko.1: Latent defects undetected in testing phase, server capacity reduction, and increased traffic converged to cause global outage, with failure to isolate faults within individual network segments accelerating propagation.
